purpose: Motion-sensitive cached contour candidate: keep the static replay cache interval, but refresh color contour/stereo estimates when visual motion, unknown spike, or far stereo loss suggests the cache is stale.
expected_effect: Match candidate_0014 cost on static frames.
Refresh cached color/stereo contours when motion-sensitive replay indicates stale ownership.
Reduce contour lag risk before promoting cached stereo rough distance into live-motion use.
risk: Motion-triggered refresh can reintroduce heavy gray_prepare_ms spikes.
The current motion trigger is image-difference based and uses a conservative 25% change threshold until dedicated motion replay cases exist.
